infoLinks.urlText: Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Anzac Pde and the footbridge is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Anzac Pde and the footbridge is temporarily out of service.
The lifts at Moore Park Light Rail stop will be out of service until further notice while replacement works are carried out. The outage is expected to continue for at least four weeks.
During this period, use the accessible entry/exit pathway via the crossing at the intersection of Anzac Pde and Lang Rd, or via the Entertainment Quarter side, or use the stairs at this stop if you are able to do so safely.
Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
